notes.title: 🎮 Hamstermind’s demo will be playable on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
🎮 Good news!

The Hamstermind demo, launching on May 25, is fully playable on Steam Deck:

- Controller is supported out-of-the-box (Steam Deck layout)
- UI is sharp and fully readable at 1280x800
- Smooth performance, no issues

While Valve doesn’t officially verify demos, we’ve made sure the experience is great for Steam Deck players.

notes.title: 🎉 Hamstermind demo is coming on May 29!
notes.content:
🎉 Great news!

Hamstermind has been selected for the [b]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase ![/b]
This event highlights some of the best puzzle games out there… and our demo will be playable for free on Steam from **May 29 to June 5**.

🧠 Hamstermind is a quirky puzzle game where you play as Hamster Jones, exploring a mysterious pyramid full of traps, rotating rooms, and hidden secrets.

We can't wait to hear what you think. Get ready to twist your brain… in every direction! 😉

➡ Add Hamstermind to your wishlist so you don’t miss the demo launch
